source_files: marketing/instagram/2026-11-12-reel-2/04-render-spec.json (items.R2 v2: intro, gold piece, labels, end card, styles)

display.note: Cormorant has no Armenian glyphs: Armenian falls back to Noto Serif Armenian (intended). Latin/digits render in Cormorant.

logo.note: File names are inverted vs. intuition: garon-logo-dark.* is the WHITE/gold logo (for dark backgrounds), as used by components/Logo.tsx with light=true. Round 1: vector logo, viewBox 0 0 425 310 (same box as the old 425x310 PNG, so all x/y/w/h below are unchanged). The mark was REDRAWN (commit 5958932), visible content bbox in viewBox units x 32.5..388.5, y 24..290 (old raster: 29..392, 21..291). garon-mark-*.svg = mark only, viewBox 70 16 288 168 (not used in this batch).

R3.title: «Գծագիր → Իրականություն» v2 — architect line drawings of real interiors materialize into the photographs (fast cuts, 5 rooms)
R3.honesty: After the intro every photo is a licensed Unsplash ILLUSTRATIVE interior (marketing/instagram/assets/stock/CREDITS.md), NOT a GARON project. The line drawings are generated from those photos (04-R3-prep.py). Nothing says or implies «մեր աշխատանքը/our project»; the caption says it is a visualization with illustrative interiors (03-copy.json R3).
R3.replaced_v1: v1 (procedural flat SVG room, built stage by stage) replaced on owner feedback 2026-11-12: «Make it REALISTIC» + «fast, quick cuts, several shots».
R3.renderer: marketing/instagram/2026-11-12-reel-3-renovation/04-R3-renderer.js — usage: NODE_PATH=$(npm root -g) node 04-R3-renderer.js <repo_root> <out_dir> [all|cover|0,30,...]. Step 1 (automatic if <out_dir>/_prep/manifest.json is missing): python3 04-R3-prep.py <repo_root> <out_dir>/_prep → crops <id>.jpg + line drawings <id>_lines.json. Writes R3_%03d.png, R3_cover.png, measure.json; f0–179 are delegated to tools/render_l02_frames.js. If code and spec disagree, the spec wins.
R3.encode: python3 marketing/instagram/tools/compose_l02_audio.py intro_r3.wav --intro-only && ffmpeg -framerate 30 -i R3_%03d.png -i intro_r3.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v libx264 -profile:v high -pix_fmt yuv420p -crf 18 -colorspace bt709 -color_primaries bt709 -color_trc bt709 -c:a aac -b:a 192k -ar 48000 -t 26 -movflags +faststart R3_reel.mp4 ; cover: python3 marketing/instagram/tools/png2jpg.py R3_cover.png R3_cover.jpg 92

timebase.note: intro 0–179 (= L02 v4, 3 bars); every cut and every reveal starts on a beat (multiples of 15) — details are 1-beat inserts; f780 = clean loop

acts.what: identical L02 v4 logo build (no text)

gold piece opens the window on paper; the architect drawing of the living room draws itself (182–236); 240 downbeat: the photo materializes from the lamp light (grey structure → colour → warm bloom), lines fade; 270 + 285: two 1-beat angle inserts (lamp/windows, chair/pampas)
cut to the kitchen drawing (300–326), 330 materialize, 360 detail insert (lemons/pot/marble)
bathroom drawing (375–401), 405 materialize from the window, 435 detail insert (basin/tap)
one beat each: drawing 450, reality 465 (fast wipe), detail 480
final room: drawing 495–523, 525 materialize, 552 handle, 570 sweep back to the drawing, 600 split «Գծագիր | Իրականություն», 645 release
= v1/R2 v2 end card: logo, services line, horizon, garon.am

z_order: scene window (clip): per shot one camera wrapper = [paper+grid] [photo grey] [photo colour] [bloom] [line drawing SVG + gold dims]; final shot also a plan copy (paper+grid+lines+dims) in a clip box left of the divider

theme.note: = R2 v2 theme (paper #f5f5f3, dark gold #856727 for thin lines/small text on paper, light gold #c9a96a for the divider/handle ring and the gold piece). The room uses its own muted warm palette (room.palette).
theme.logo_note: garon-logo-light.svg = DARK logo for LIGHT backgrounds (fills #1e1e1e, gradients gmlight #a3a3a3→#4f4f4f and gglight #d4b57a→#b8955c). Path data and the <rect> are byte-identical to garon-logo-dark.svg, so every geometry number of v2 (clips, pieces, wordmark glyph bounds, box) is unchanged.

easings.note: CSS cubic-bezier(x1,y1,x2,y2) control points; evaluate exactly like CSS (solve x(t)=p by Newton/bisection, return y(t)).

R3.keyframes_rule: Every animated property is a list of keys [frame, value, easing]. Before the first key: first value; after the last key: last value. Between key k and k+1: v = v_k + (v_k+1 − v_k) · E((f − f_k)/(f_k+1 − f_k)), E = easing NAMED IN KEY k (see `easings`). "hold" = keep v_k until f_k+1 then jump. Vector values ([x,y] or {x,y,w,h}) interpolate component-wise.

window.note: = R2 window. All shot geometry (crops, line drawings, dims, bloom points) is in WINDOW-LOCAL coordinates: fractions of 940×1253 or px.

vlines.note: v2: = L02 v4 keys (fade-in 176–196 starts inside the borrowed intro; continuous across f179→f180)

blueprint.css: background-image: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(23,25,28,.11) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(23,25,28,.11) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(to right, rgba(23,25,28,.045) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(23,25,28,.045) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 180px 180px, 180px 180px, 36px 36px, 36px 36px; background-position: 0 27px, 0 27px, 0 27px, 0 27px; -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(620px 760px at 540px 980px, #000 35%, transparent 100%)

window_grid.note: drawn inside the window SVG, aligned to the full-frame L02 grid (global origin 0,27)

blueprint.used_by: window background of both plan and result SVG; cover

intro.source: IDENTICAL to L02 v4 frames 0–179: items.L02 of marketing/instagram/2026-11-11-launch/04-render-spec.json (stage, build, blueprint, ground_line, dimensions, glint, wordmark, vlines, theme, easings), rendered by marketing/instagram/tools/render_l02_frames.js. Do NOT copy or edit those keys here — the R2 renderer runs the L02 renderer for f0–179 and renames L02_%03d.png → R2_%03d.png (pixel-identical by construction; verified by pixel diff).
intro.what: L02 v4 logo build-up: blueprint grid, ground line draws from the centre (6–36), stems rise (45/50/55), roof bands slide (60–), gold piece lands with shake + impact glow at f105 (3.5 s), camera pull-back 120–148, glint 124–150 + wordmark tracks in, finished lockup = garon-logo-light.svg at 200,700 680×496 from f148; real logo from f167. No text, no grain, no corner logo, no labels in f0–179.

camera_exit.what: f180+: the finished lockup (logo 680×496 at 200,700, transform-origin 342.4px 158px) continues exactly as in L02: scale = exit_scale_mul, opacity = exit_opacity; hidden after f198

intro.replaced_v1: v1 outline → pour intro (f0–135, horizon shutter at f120) removed on owner feedback 2026-11-12 (L02 intro was better).

entry.note: = R2 v2 pair H entry: the gold piece of the finished L02 lockup grows into the window (g = 1.6·32^inOutCubic((f−180)/12)) and opens on the blueprint sheet; the lockup pushes in and fades under it (intro.camera_exit). The scene window div sits at (70,390): its clip polygon = (gold polygon ∩ window) − (70,390).

gold_piece.shape_note: the GOLD path of the logo relative to its anchor (330, 132.5) in mark units
gold_piece.g: px per unit: g = 1.6 for f ≤ e; g = 1.6·32^E((f−e)/12) for e < f ≤ e+12, E = inOutCubic (→ 51.2: the polygon covers the window from e+12)
gold_piece.formula: incoming shot layer clipped to (anchor + g·shape_unit) ∩ window

gold_fill.css: same clip polygon filled with linear-gradient(135deg,#d4b57a,#b8955c), layer above the shots
gold_fill.opacity: relative keys [[e−4,0,outSine],[e−1,1,hold],[e+3,1,outSine],[e+10,0]] — a small solid gold piece (141 px wide) appears in the window centre on the beat before e, then grows and opens into the next shot

grain.css: full-frame div, background = 256x256 grayscale noise tile (deterministic PRNG seed 7, values 128±40), mix-blend-mode overlay, opacity 0.05; background-position shifts every 2 frames by ((37·k) mod 256, (91·k) mod 256), k = floor(f/2)
grain.note: paper texture, invisible on a phone at arm's length but kills the 'flat digital' look; v2: OFF in f0–179 (the borrowed L02 intro has no grain, frames must stay identical), fades in 180–196 (keys `opacity`)

layers.note: same y as the L02 intro ground line (1107 ± 1) → the line that closes the reel opens it again on loop

end_card.rules: NO CTA, NO @handle, NO date. Only: logo, services line, garon.am (owner-preferences.md). v2 (owner feedback): the «Առաջ | Հետո» line with its divider + small handle is REMOVED from the end card (the top-right stage labels during the photo sections stay).
end_card.spacing_note: v2 re-balance in the rhythm of the L02 v4 end card (logo → 49 px → rule → 38 px → line, then air → horizon → garon.am): logo visible 583–833, rule 882, services 920–≈950, horizon 1106 (≈156 px below the services line; L02: 129), garon.am 1146–≈1183. Block 583–1183 sits around the optical centre; below y 1100 only garon.am (x ≈ 470–610, < 900).

R3.photo_note: every crop is 3:4 and is resampled to photo_px = window × max_push (1034×1378), shown at 940×1253 × camera scale. Upscale vs source pixels = 940·scale / crop_width_px ≤ 1.35 for every shot (checked: prep manifest max_upscale_vs_source at 1.10; real camera max 1.08 → details 1.35, rooms ≤ 1.02).

line_art.what: architect sketch generated from the crop itself (04-R3-prep.py): straight structure = LSD segments (merged, overshoot at both ends like a hand-drafted line), objects = cleaned Canny chains; no hatching, no texture

construction.note: longest straight edges extended edge-to-edge, faint — the drafting guide lines drawn first

draw.note: t0/t1 are fractions of the shot sketch.draw window; each path = SVG path with pathLength 1, stroke-dashoffset 1→0 (outCubic) between t0 and t1

dims.at_note: optional per-dim `at` (0–1) = position of the figure along the line (default 0.5)
dims.draw: starts at 55% of the sketch window, 10 frames; text fades in after
dims.note: illustrative figures (mm) — this is a drawing language, not a survey

shots.what: leather sling chair, pampas, sofa end

shots.blur_note: cookbook spines (readable titles) blurred, feathered (reads as depth of field)

circles.note: two round rattan mirrors → clean circles (HoughCircles)

shots.blur_note: coffee-table book title blurred (soft, reads as depth of field)

shots_rules.cut: hard cut at frames[0] of every shot (on the beat); sketch.draw may start BEFORE frames[0] (rooms 2–5: 5–7 frames) so the first frame after the cut already shows the guide lines (no blank paper flash); the camera wrapper of a shot is visible only inside its frames (inclusive), the final shot to 779 under the end veil
shots_rules.sketch: paper #f5f5f3 + window grid (blueprint.window_grid) + line drawing drawn in over sketch.draw; gold dims draw at 55% of the window
shots_rules.reveal: wipe: photo layers appear through a mask — radial (soft disc from origin_frac, radius 0 → 1.25·window diagonal, soft edge 260 px) or linear (left → right, soft edge 260 px) — eased inOutSine over reveal.wipe; grey stage: CSS filter grayscale(1) contrast(1.04) brightness(1.05) on the photo; colour: grayscale goes 1 → 0 over reveal.colour; lines: opacity 1 → 0 over reveal.lines_out (mix-blend multiply while on the photo); bloom: warm radial glows at points [fx, fy, r (fraction of window width), peak], screen blend, colour rgba(255,214,160), opacity × bloom.frames
shots_rules.detail: photo only (no drawing) in full colour, 1-beat insert with its own fast push (≤ 1.08 → ≤ 1.35× source px)
shots_rules.drift: all shots: micro drift dx = 2·sin(f/41), dy = 1.6·sin(f/53 + 1) px (as v1)

R3.labels_note: section «ՎԵՐԱՆՈՐՈԳՈՒՄ · <ROOM>» (Montserrat/Noto Sans Armenian 500 18 px, 0.24em, uppercase) + stage word «Գծագիր» / «Իրականություն» (Noto Serif Armenian 500 40 px #856727), right-aligned to x 1010, y 270/294 — same slots as R2/v1. Stage switches on the reveal beat; during the slider when the divider crosses the middle (≈580, ≈651). Labels change at hard cuts with a 5-frame rise.

indicator.what: = R2 indicator (x 874–1010, y 352): room k of 5 → fill k/5; slider: fill = 1 − p

slider.p_note: p ∈ [0,1], divider x (window-local) = 940·p. LEFT of the divider = Գծագիր (beige_wide drawing on paper + grid + dims, same camera), right = Իրականություն (photo). p = 0: photo.

light_leaks.css: div 900x900, radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(255,214,150,0.9), rgba(201,169,106,0.35) 45%, rgba(201,169,106,0) 100%), mix-blend-mode screen, centred (cx, cy)

cover.what: the idea in one still: final room split at p = 0.5 — left the architect drawing, right the real photo, gold divider + handle; chips «ԳԾԱԳԻՐ» / «ԻՐԱԿԱՆՈՒԹՅՈՒՆ», section «ՎԵՐԱՆՈՐՈԳՈՒՄ · ՀՅՈՒՐԱՍԵՆՅԱԿ», stage «Գծագիր | Իրականություն», corner logo, blueprint around the window
cover.grid_check: profile grid 3:4 (y 240–1680) contains logo, labels and the whole window

audio.file_rule: Owner preference: ONLY the intro has sound, then silence. `python3 marketing/instagram/tools/compose_l02_audio.py intro_r3.wav --intro-only` (26.0 s WAV = reel length; sound 0–6.0 s, digital silence after).

beat_map.event: DOWNBEAT — music starts: gold piece opens the paper, living-room drawing draws in
reveal 1 — living room materializes from the lamp light
slider sweeps back to the drawing

audio.mood: In-app track by MOOD, not by name: modern minimal / architectural, warm, ~120 BPM with a clear pulse (cuts land on beats), felt piano or soft pluck + light percussion, no vocals, no EDM drop. Start at 6.0 s.

checks: ffprobe: 1080x1920, 30 fps, 780 frames, 26.000 s, yuv420p, AAC (intro sound 0–6.0 s, then silence)
f0–179 = L02 v4 frames (rendered by render_l02_frames.js)
No text in f0–189; no hook, no CTA, no @handle; end card = logo, services line, garon.am
Photos: only the 5 licensed Unsplash interiors (CREDITS.md); no people, no readable brands; nothing called «մեր աշխատանքը»
Every crop ≤ 1.35× source pixels at max camera scale (prep manifest)
Line drawings: clean lines, no texture noise (review <id>_lines.png with --debug)
Stage label matches the divider side (switch at p = 0.5)
R3.alt_hy: Կարճ տեսանյութ բաց ֆոնի վրա։ Ճարտարապետական ցանցի վրա կառուցվում է GARON նշանը, և նրա ոսկեգույն մասը բացում է թղթի թերթը։ Բարակ մատիտային գծերով գծվում է հյուրասենյակի ճարտարապետական գծագիրը, հետո լամպի լույսից «նյութականանում» է իրական սենյակը՝ նախ մոխրագույն, հետո գունավոր։ Արագ կադրեր՝ նույն սկզբունքով խոհանոց, լոգարան, ննջասենյակ և մեկ այլ հյուրասենյակ, դետալներ՝ լամպ, մարմարե սեղան, լվացարան, բարձեր։ Ոսկեգույն սահիչը ցույց է տալիս գծագիրը և իրական սենյակը կողք կողքի։ Ինտերիերները նկարազարդող են (Unsplash), ոչ GARON-ի նախագծեր։ Վերջին կադրում՝ լոգոն, «Լողավազաններ · Տներ · Վերանորոգում» և garon.am։
